effects.glb_contains: nothing (tube positions in 'tubes': [x, y_bottom, z, height, radius])
effects.godot_runtime: ONE MeshInstance3D: an ArrayMesh of camera-facing quads (4 verts per bubble: VERTEX = tube bottom centre, UV = corner, COLOR = random seed, UV2 = (height, radius)) + tube_bubbles.gdshader, which moves every bubble up its tube in the vertex shader (rises faster as it goes, wobbles, grows a little, fades in at the nozzles and pops under the hood) and draws a glassy rim + highlights. render_priority -1 so the tinted glass is drawn over it. No CPU work, one draw call
OmniLight3D per position (no shadows): light_color, light_energy, omni_range

effects.glb_contains: rotor mesh at rest, own node
effects.godot_runtime: script: rotor node.rotate_object_local(Vector3.UP, rpm * TAU / 60 * delta); the rotor's node origin is its centre and its local +y its axis (per-target rpm in 'speeds', sign = direction)

effects.glb_contains: parcels, parts and arms at rest (own nodes: mobile groups; arms skinned to one skeleton each)
effects.godot_runtime: script (apply_effects.gd _assembly): every node of the line's 'move' groups (<group>__*) slides along 'axis' by fmod(t * speed, spacing); per station the arm's groups turn about 'hinge' through 'pivot' by angle_deg * bump(t - t0, window) every 'period' s, 'held' groups hide from t0 to t0 + 0.6 period, 'scan' groups show only during the dip, and the 'reveal' group gets assembly_reveal.gdshader (fragments with dot(world, plane.xyz) < plane.w discarded: parts appear once the parcel passes the arm). Stage 65/66: a station with 'rig' drives the arm's Skeleton3D instead - bone pose rotation about each joint's rest axis (turret yaw, shoulder, elbow, wrist = -(shoulder + elbow), claw twist, 3 fingers) from the rig's motion program (pipeline/arm_motion.py: jerk-limited servo moves, conveyor tracking, inverse kinematics every frame; no sway)

effects.glb_contains: ram (head + rod) at rest, own nodes (mobile group); pad, column and housing static
effects.godot_runtime: script (apply_effects.gd _crushers): the ram's group nodes (<group>__*) sit at rest raised 'travel' m; every 'period' s (offset 'phase'): 'warn' s of warning (lamps pulse), a 'down' s slam onto the pad (accelerating), 'hold' s pressed, a 'rise' s climb back (eased). While pressed an Area3D over the pad ('kill' box, world) is enabled in the hazard group: anything standing there dies

effects.glb_contains: the turbine (rotor on its own node)
effects.godot_runtime: script (apply_effects.gd _winds): with a 'trigger' sphere strength s = 1 until a CharacterBody3D enters it (or stop_wind(id)), then 1 - smoothstep over 'spin_down' s, for good; without one, a cycle of period ramp + blast + ramp + calm (offset 'phase'): strength s rises (smoothstep) over 'ramp' s, holds 1 for 'blast' s, falls over 'ramp' s, 0 for 'calm' s. The rotor node turns at rpm * (idle + (1 - idle) s). A CharacterBody3D inside the cone (from 'origin' along 'dir', radius 'radius' + 'spread' * distance, 'length' m) is moved (move_and_collide) push * s * (1 - 0.35 d / length) m/s along dir and, while airborne, velocity.y += lift * s * delta. Wind streaks: CPUParticles3D along dir while s > 0.25

wind.note: force = push along dir (x strength), lift while airborne; inside the cone only

effects.glb_contains: the model parts at rest, own nodes (mobile group)
effects.godot_runtime: script (apply_effects.gd _bobs): every node of the group (<group>__*) is turned and lifted about 'pivot' (world): y offset amp * sin(2 pi (t + phase) / period), a sway of 'sway' deg about x (sin, period * 1.3) and z (cos, period * 1.7) and a slow yaw drift (sway * 0.6 deg, period * 2.3) - a body drifting in liquid (Stage 92)

effects.glb_contains: pads at the RAISED position (skinned, one mesh per material); colliders at the raised position
effects.godot_runtime: script (apply_effects.gd _risers): pads skinned to one skeleton (bone <id>_J<k> per pad, <id>_R<k> per surge ring); all start 'rise' m under the liquid (rings hidden under it). When a CharacterBody3D enters the trigger sphere pad k starts after k * stagger s: offset = -rise * (1 - u)^3 over rise_s s (u = t / rise_s: bursts up, decelerates), then a damped bob 0.22 sin(9 t') e^(-4 t') for 1.4 s; its surge ring bursts out from 35 % of the rise (scale 0.4 -> 3.0 over 1.6 s, ease-out) while sinking 0.9 m back under the surface. The pad's colliders (collision.glb nodes named after 'colliders') are disabled until 85 % of its rise. Stage 89/91: a pad with 'drips' drops goo (CPUParticles3D) once up; with 'goo' {drips, strands, hold, fade} those bones drain away 'hold' s after it is up over 'fade' s (smoothstep: drips scale y -> 0 sliding 0.6 m down, strands scale -> 0) and the drops stop

riser.note: pads start under the liquid; they surge up in order when a player enters the trigger sphere
